flow.contract: sequence executes instructions in order; repeat locks the count once; optional confirms at resolution; ifThen reads the selected condition.

resources.contract: draw(count,side,{ephemeral}), discard(count,side), erode(count,side), gainEnergy and gainPoints; empty-deck draws/erodes cause Fatigue, whole-hand discard can read handSize before its instruction.

foresee.contract: foresee reads count, privately arranges its top cards and moves selected cards to void; empty deck does nothing.

discover.contract: discover filter uses effective type and copiable cost; private matching deck offer, chosen hand arrival and shuffle.

activation.contract: activated costs use timing, prepare mandatory X before targets, plan all payments, commit, pay and persist origin/X/optional flags; standard/Fast/Interrupt are distinct.

select.contract: current controller/type/another/spark/cost/challenging selectors; anyOf forms OR leaves with outer AND; bounds rechecked at resolution.

values.contract: count(character selector), filtered public void count, public hand/deck size, times/plus/locked, resolving/source stored X and retained source spark; static readers use earlier layers.

triggers.contract: named/either, filtered play/materialize/discard/draw/abandon/dissolve/challengeWith/startOfTurn triggers; nth play/draw already exists; oncePerTurn consumed on the actual matched occasion; functional void zone allowed.

spark.contract: gainSpark gives a retained/permanent increment; sparkModifier is live static spark; supported(...) determines adjacent front cards from a back source; sourceSpark is pre-departure effective source spark, not paid other-character spark.

materialize.contract: materialize names every/top/random/self/target zone cards; zone order controls arrivals, character filter and ordinary capacity/exhausted/awakened rules; random exact cost reads resolving X and uses deterministic selection stream.

figments.contract: materializeFigments accepts resolving count and printed figment subtype/spark; ordinary capacity and created-card rules apply.

counter-fixed.contract: storeCounters increments a source still in play; fixed counter costs spend exact stored counters, persist payment and event; after departure storage does nothing.

counter-dynamic.contract: stored counter numeric reader, static live bounds, pre-departure retained count and X counter-payment preparation absent. Reuse95; fixed-counter support does not supply these.

history.contract: current turnLog records play/draw/materialize but no declarative count/condition over past discards/dissolves/leavesPlay or matching current void cards. Reuse100, with pre-departure controller and physical identity snapshots; do not approximate by live zone counts.

cost-offset.contract: costModifier filters each player play and applies increases/reductions; selfCostReduction computes a live physical source reduction; card cost increases following a hand move use modifyCardCost.

cost-first.contract: first filtered play modifier and set-zero base semantics need canonical104; offset-only next/permanent costModifier does not encode first-this-turn nor a per-matching-card base setter.

cost-zero.contract: Nexus global filtered set-zero is absent. Reuse104 set-zero component by fresh scope/acceptance confirmation, or file a precise separate extension only if104 explicitly declines it. Fixed -2 is incorrect with later increases and alternative route semantics.

alternative.contract: full replacement payment route for hand/void plus conditional survivor permission and route-specific awakened entry need103; current PlayRoute costs enumerate hand/permission/offering/reclaim.

play-condition.contract: announcement-time void-event-count requirement needs105; resolving ifThen and static matching restriction cannot substitute for checked play eligibility.

optional-target.contract: single unpaid bounded or paid unrestricted target requires prepared optional-cost decision before target and payment after commit; resolution ifThen walks both targets and is not equivalent.

hand-choice.contract: private optional one-character materialization from own hand; every/random/self/top/void target are not a private exact hand choice.

deck-condition.contract: top-only matching condition and empty-deck-safe fallback draw; whole deck count/filter and normal draw Fatigue differ.

abandon-spark.contract: capture paid character effective spark as plan X before departure; captureCost is copiable cost and sourceSpark is source, so neither substitutes.

discard-filter-count.contract: resolution-local count of actual event cards discarded by this instruction; moved capture stores costs and live zone counts/history do not bind instruction-local discard type.

discard-batch.contract: active453 owns the one-or-more discard occasion and captured count for Key Sifter, including its module. Staging lacks it; private active branch outcome unknown; no ownership/edge change.

stack-bounds.contract: stack selector filters only controller/type/preventability; cost/spark upper bounds absent. Reuse97 for prevent cards and Veilpiercer.

stack-return.contract: Veilpiercer needs typed stack-card-to-hand primitive extension. Existing returnToHand CharacterRef and returnFromVoid zone guard cannot name its chosen stack card; low-level relocation already cleans matching stack card.

hand-activation.contract: Vaultbreaker needs a hand source activation and forced reveal of that physical source as payment. Existing generic reveal cost picks arbitrary matching hand cards; source reduction reuses changeCardCost via SelfSpec extension, not a new cost primitive.

copy.contract: repeat(2,copyCard(triggeringCard())) calls ordinary copyOnStack twice against original, retaining original X/optionalPaid and per-copy retargeting. delayed/floating event filters are staged.99 remains its original validation owner; source composition is not executed behavior proof.

reclaim.contract: printed explicit reclaim, grantReclaim filtered void targets/every/subject and expiry are staged. Known372 retains effective-keyword loss repair as a final acceptance dependency where relevant.

permission.contract: playFromZone void/deck permission; oncePerTurn static allowance; identified current deck top required. revealDeckTop condition and separately stated permission apply independently.

alltypes.contract: giveAllTypes static layer2 self works with every subtype selector/filter; current earlier layer reading applies.

returns.contract: returnAllButOne chooses keep without targeting, counts successful hand arrivals only; floating dissolve -> returnFromVoid(triggeringCard()) can return the actual subject; ordinary replacements retained.

shuffle.contract: shuffleInto(every hand,every void) moves actual cards and uses deterministic side shuffle; created/reclaimed replacements and knowledge forgetting included.

banish.contract: banish selected current character; subtype and anyOf alternative apply; fixed void banish payment can name either public void.

control.contract: gainControl uses X-bounded enemy target and ordinary controller transfer/capacity.

whisper-payment.contract: A deck-count>=3 guard plus optional(sequence(erode(3),putInDeck(sourceVoid,top))) may compose the resolving erode payment; exact affordability/Fatigue/payment semantics require D10/scenario proof. Do not add a speculative erode-payment framework.
